assert all_Bits_Set_In_The_Given_Range(17,2,4) == True
assert all_Bits_Set_In_The_Given_Range(39,4,6) == False

Write the t task named `all_Bits_Set_In_The_Given_Range` with 3 parameter(s) of type(s) int, int, int, in the order the tests pass them, returning bool. The tests must pass and the ensures must specify the result.

```t
task all_Bits_Set_In_The_Given_Range(n: int, l: int, r: int) returns (res: bool)
  requires l >= 1
  requires r >= l
  ensures res == (forall i in [l, r+1) . (n mod (2 * (2 ^ (i - 1))) < (2 ^ (i - 1))))
{
  var mask: int := 0;
  var i: int := l;
  while i <= r
    invariant i >= l and i <= r + 1
    decreases r - i + 1
  {
    var power: int := 1;
    var j: int := 0;
    while j < i - 1
      invariant power == 2 ^ j
      invariant j >= 0 and j <= i - 1
      decreases i - 1 - j
    {
      power := power * 2;
      j := j + 1;
    }
    mask := mask + power;
    i := i + 1;
  }
  res := (n * 0 + mask) == 0 or (n mod (mask + 1)) == 0;
}
```
